parent_findings: Unconditional transition exits reduced BULL and RANGE expectancy.
Loss-conditioned transition exits did not pass the locked cross-year adoption gates.
hypothesis: An existing LONG should inherit the destination lane's exit horizon only when the same asset satisfies the destination lane's completed-bar entry conditions at the confirmed transition. This preserves a valid position instead of blindly retaining the origin exit or crystallizing a mean-reversion loss.

BEAR.entry: -0.20 <= btc30d <= -0.10 and atr_ratio >= 1.60 and bb_pos <= -0.90 and bb_pos_1h_ago > -0.90 and quote_volume_24h >= 50000000

policies.HANDOFF_KEEP_1: At first completed destination-regime bar: if destination entry is eligible, replace exit horizon with destination horizon; otherwise keep original fixed exit.
policies.HANDOFF_KEEP_4: Same after four consecutive destination-regime completed bars.
policies.HANDOFF_EXIT_1: If eligible, hand off; if ineligible, exit at next 15m open.
policies.HANDOFF_EXIT_4: Same after four consecutive destination-regime completed bars.

execution.handoff_exit_price: close of the bar at handoff signal plus destination hold hours

deployment_constraint: Historical data are consumed; a passing handoff policy remains shadow-only until forward parity and live reconciliation are observed.
